purpose: Reference-only drug-perturbation model (kept for comparison): WAVE GeneDrugFusion

sources.method: git clone <url> source/ && git -C source checkout <commit> && rm -rf source/.git

note: manifest, verified_at, verify_result and tree_sha256 are filled by ticket 09; asset files/bytes are subsets of the source/ tree recorded on repository entries
notes: Reference-only: no dose input, fails the revised G2 gate, so not deployed. Absorbed from the deleted VALIDATION.md: a 1-epoch end-to-end train/test on a synthetic 978-gene h5ad passes (Pearson 0.0003, R2 -0.0142, dGene Pearson 0.7033) but the model class hardcodes 978 genes; upstream bug: train_model saves best_model.pth to the CWD while test_model looks under --outdir (running with --outdir . makes the smoke pass). Absorbed from download/manual.md section 1: pretrained model + preprocessed LINCS/sci-Plex h5ads are on FigShare 29650832 (DOI 10.1038/s41467-026-77645-3), browser-only.
